json_structure_validator.description: Validates that the response is valid JSON with required story structure

story_quality_metrics.description: Evaluates story quality and keyword integration

story_agent_specifics: Schema version 2; valid JSON with exactly six scenes indexed 1–6
Beats: setup, inciting_incident, first_attempt, setback, climax, resolution
Each scene text is 25–50 words; total story is 180–270 words
Only declared main characters appear in scene.characters
The story equals the six scene texts joined in order
Golden responses are regression fixtures, not proof of live model quality
trajectory_expectations: Story agent uses direct LLM response (no tools)
Response should be immediate and complete
